title: Confusing
label: Confusing, a skill for reporting Astrolabe moments that read unclear
creator: Danny
creatorRole: who teaches the course Astrolabe came out of
promise: One-click confusion reporting: drag-select crop on a Mac desktop, or paste a screenshot (works anywhere, including a phone), with code diagnosis and a clean GitHub issue filed with one approval.

hero.alt: A cropped Astrolabe UI element with an issue draft showing code location and a single approval button

changes.note: First release: files Astrolabe confusions as GitHub issues from screenshots.
Reuses the 'Make it yours' in-place pattern without starting a new chat: drag-select crop on a Mac desktop, or paste a screenshot (works anywhere, including a phone), and names missing dependencies.

desc: Free, and part of the members' skills library. Found something in Astrolabe that reads unclear? Operates in place without switching to a new chat tab: drag-select crop on a Mac desktop, or paste a screenshot (works anywhere, including a phone). Diagnoses the file:line in code, and drafts a clean GitHub issue filed after exactly one yes. Built on GitHub CLI gh (MIT license) and screencapture on macOS.
bio: Danny teaches the course Astrolabe came out of. He built this to keep feedback loops frictionless without leaving the screen.

steps: add the Confusing skill to your notes folder, so every assistant has it
if Claude Code is here, also add the plugin marketplace goggledefogger/skills-town and install report-confusion
pin the Confusing button to your Astrolabe rituals shelf
install.updates: Auto-updates once that marketplace has it switched on; on any other agent, updating the skill file brings the next version.
install.touches: Adds the skill to your notes folder's skills, plus the Claude Code plugin if Claude Code is here, and a card to your Astrolabe rituals shelf. Reads captured screenshots in tools/screens and creates GitHub issues via gh. Writes nothing into your notes.
